about: Round 78, task 16: rule conditions over an operand in a special state, asked through check/filter v1 in two forms: an ALLOW rule without predicates whose condition is the probe, and the same rule with `<probe> OR <true for the subject>`, each beside an ALLOW rule with the predicate a==1.
